name: scroll-and-swap
title: Scroll and Swap Text
description: A tall column of bold text scrolls smoothly; as any line crosses the middle band it slides away and an identical copy slides in behind it, so the list appears to roll over itself.
use: A credits, member or name list should feel alive while the user scrolls through it, with each row renewing itself.
avoid: Every line exists twice in the DOM, so very long lists cost more, and it needs a scroll container wired by ref.
a11y: Reduced-motion is ignored, and the scroll container is not focusable, so keyboard users cannot scroll it without a pointer. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bright blue panel filled edge to edge with white, bold, uppercase names stacked tightly down the centre. Each line is centred and large; a small 'SCROLL SLOWLY' note sits in the top corner.
behaves: Scrolling glides the whole column upward. When a line enters the swap band it lifts away while a duplicate rises from below into its place, so briefly two copies overlap before one settles.
customise: Each line takes its text as children and accepts the tag, scroll offset pair, spring settings and container ref; the type, colour and column width are set by the parent.
weight: moderate: Over a hundred text elements each track scroll progress, though only a screenful shows.

props.name: springConfig
props.type: { stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number }
